messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: [sev-2] idp-audit-indexer detected anomalous export to external S3 bucket at 2026-03-18T02:44:55Z. Possible PII in payloads. Alert: https://alerts.redwood/internal/2087654322 :rotating_light:
alice (eng-oncall): ack, I'm taking a look. do we know which bucket? any signs of reads?
incident-bot: Details: service=auditlog-indexer wrote 3 objects to s3://redwood-external-archive/tmp/ingest-2026-03-18.tar.gz (120MB total). DLP flagged patterns: "X-Auth-JWT" fragments and email-like strings. source_task=c9f3b7a.
bryan (sec): on it. I'll revoke the upload role's temporary creds now and block outbound S3 in the indexer task role. rotating keys + diag, ETA ~10m.
marta (sre): prepping a fast deploy to disable external uploads (feature flag OFF). will restart indexer-prod pool in ~2m.
alice (eng-oncall): quick sample from indexer stdout (truncated):
```
[2026-03-18T02:44:55Z] audit:login user=joe@acme-corp.com src=52.14.72.1 token=eyJhbGci...<redacted>
```
looks like header fragments included in the payload.
zach (cust-ops): any customer-impact yet? no support tickets on this so far but we should pre-draft comms.
bryan (sec): treating as potential exposure. checking S3 bucket ownership/ACLs. initial metadata: bucket owner != our org. object ACLs appear private but we can't assume not accessible. starting S3 access-log query.
alice (eng-oncall): found 4 more batches queued for upload. cancelling queued uploads and requeueing to internal archive. running: `kubectl exec -c admin indexer-prod -- /admin/cancel-uploads`
incident-bot: Created ticket INF-6241, severity set to P2. Pager: bryan, alice, marta. Handoff checkpoint set for 04:00 UTC.
bryan (sec): rotating indexer-upload-role keys, revoked active STS sessions for that role. creating new role with s3:PutObject restricted to our internal bucket only. KMS key rotation scheduled.
leon (legal): please gather list of potentially affected tenants. we need that before deciding notification scope. hold public comms until we have evidence.
alice (eng-oncall): extracting tenant ids from the 3 artifacts now. preliminary: tenants: ["acme-corp", "powell-ai"]. will paste exact event counts in 15m.
zach (cust-ops): draft internal comms stub: :warning: "Potential exposure of audit logs from indexer; investigation ongoing. We will notify affected customers if confirmed." i'll prepare customer-facing template if legal gives greenlight.
marta (sre): deploy finished, external upload feature flag OFF, all indexer containers restarted. confirmed queued uploads cancelled at 02:55 UTC.
alice (eng-oncall): re-ingested 4 cancelled batches into redwood-internal-archive for analysis. running DLP checks on the re-ingested dataset.
bryan (sec): S3 access logs show a single HEAD request from an external IP at 02:45:03Z (matches upload time). no GETs observed so far. continuing forensic to confirm object pop/pull.
leon (legal): if exposure confirmed, we need a timeline, tenant mapping, and list of data types (emails, session headers, tokens). keep all artifacts and ensure chain-of-custody.
zach (cust-ops): customer impact table (draft): acme-corp -> likely email addresses + session header fragments; powell-ai -> identifiers only. ETA full table 60m.
bryan (sec): opening SIEM timeline and starting a replay of indexer tasks. escalation plan: handoff to sec-night oncall at 04:00 UTC. leaving notes in INF-6241.
alice (eng-oncall): leaving at 03:30 UTC; handing active work to marta. notes added: canceled uploads, re-ingested to internal archive, grep queries run for token patterns.
marta (sre): I'll cover until 04:30 UTC. monitoring for any re-uploads and watch outbound egress. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident status updated to "Containment actions executed". INF-6241 updated with recent actions.
notes: containment focused (disable external uploads, cancel queues, key rotation) + customer impact assessment and legal hold. Handoff planned to night sec at 04:00 UTC.
